decision_rule: Candidate-only diagnostic, not production promotion: evaluate full native result bound to 48 predeclared T7A requests, own during-run HIP/KFD samples bound to the discovered pinned MI210 PCI/DRM/KFD identity, source/grant identity and verified cleanup. At least 5 native-timing-derived H1 modeled no-draft-to-prefill transitions, not direct graph-pin observations, and complete evidence are required. T7A sampled peak growth <=0.3 GiB is HOLDS, >0.3 GiB FAILS; insufficient evidence is UNKNOWN. Separately report sampled whole-run peak minus sampled load peak; do not use the 0.3 GiB rule for that term. The newly declared warm-up is not identical to the historical warm-up, so label this a new candidate diagnostic and do not retire the v10 registry term.
